kurals.tr: Azhivadhooum Aavadhooum Aaki Vazhipayakkum / Oodhiyamum Soozhndhu Seyal
kurals.m: Let a man reflect on what will be lost, what will be acquired and (from these) what will be his ultimate gain, and (then, let him) act

kurals.tr: Therindha Inaththotu Therndhennich Cheyvaarkku / Arumporul Yaadhondrum Il
kurals.m: There is nothing too difficult to (be attained by) those who, before they act, reflect well themselves, and thoroughly consider (the matter) with chosen friends

kurals.tr: Aakkam Karudhi Mudhalizhakkum Seyvinai / Ookkaar Arivutai Yaar
kurals.m: Wise men will not, in the hopes of profit, undertake works that will consume their principal

kurals.tr: Thelivi Ladhanaith Thotangaar Ilivennum / Edhappaatu Anju Pavar
kurals.m: Those who fear reproach will not commence anything which has not been (thoroughly considered) and made clear to them

kurals.tr: Vakaiyarach Choozhaa Thezhudhal Pakaivaraip / Paaththip Patuppadho Raaru
kurals.m: One way to promote the prosperity of an enemy, is (for a king) to set out (to war) without having thoroughly weighed his ability (to cope with its chances)

kurals.tr: Seydhakka Alla Seyak Ketum / Seydhakka Seyyaamai Yaanung Ketum
kurals.m: He will perish who does not what is not fit to do; and he also will perish who does not do what it is fit to

kurals.tr: Ennith Thunika Karumam Thunindhapin / Ennuvam Enpadhu Izhukku
kurals.m: Consider, and then undertake a matter; after having undertaken it, to say "We will consider," is folly

kurals.tr: Aatrin Varundhaa Varuththam Palarnindru / Potrinum Poththup Patum
kurals.m: The work, which is not done by suitable methods, will fail though many stand to uphold it

kurals.tr: Nandraatra Lullun Thavuruntu Avaravar / Panparin Thaatraak Katai
kurals.m: There are failures even in acting well, when it is done without knowing the various dispositions of men

kurals.tr: Ellaadha Ennich Cheyalventum Thammotu / Kollaadha Kollaadhu Ulaku
kurals.m: Let a man reflect, and do things which bring no reproach; the world will not approve, with him, of things which do not become of his position to adopt
